reserves.blocked: No committed root Cargo.lock; sparse inspection only. Requires agreed package/features, complete checkout, generated frozen lock and refreshed overlap audit before inclusion.
No committed root Cargo.lock. Codec codegen/runtime reserve only; requires frozen dependency resolution, Windows pilot and agreed test inputs before inclusion.

measurement.cold_definition: Empty unique target directory, not an OS page-cache flush. No network in timed commands.
measurement.incremental_definition: Fresh unique target seeded by the identical compiler, environment and command outside timing. No-op expects zero rebuilt artifacts; comment edit expects at least one. Neither is a semantic-edit or compiler-cache-hit guarantee.
measurement.edit: Append one Rust comment to the exact tracked source_edit file; restore original bytes in finally. Baseline revision/clean tree and lock hash are required before and after.
measurement.cpu: Total command process-tree CPU, including Cargo, rustc, linker and build scripts; not rustc-only CPU.
measurement.memory: Fresh Windows Job Object per command: peak aggregate committed Job memory and largest process committed-memory peak. Not RSS, not sum of process peaks. Existing shared-session peaks are cumulative and cannot be differenced.
measurement.runtime: Unfiltered selected correctness commands are outside the compile clock. Runtime throughput/latency and output code size are not implemented or measured here.

proposed_design.approval: User authorized remaining candidate-only breadth validation from completed custom-runner artifacts. No performance comparison or broad qualification approved.
proposed_design.pilot: fd only on MARCPE-TEST01-X64 custom runner, one round, full-check plus both incremental scenarios, existing run_scenario unfiltered debug/release correctness outside timing. Sixteen worker/affinity slots make this a diagnostic, not a comparison with historical standard four-core VM measurements. This manifest does not assert artifact capture or execution.
proposed_design.aggregation: None. Candidate-only smoke/pilot rows cannot estimate compiler speedup or qualify the held-out suite.
proposed_design.retained_roots: All three original validation roots and both reserves remain pinned for a representative lock audit. Only fd is selected for the initial pilot; other roots are not claimed measured.
